bullets.title: Another new low
bullets.text: Gold kept falling into the US close, touched 3,656.70 and sat near 3,659 at 23:07 SAST, down about 1.75% on the day (Kitco).

bullets.title: Hawkish Fed
bullets.text: After the Fed minutes, markets price about a 90-95% chance of a quarter-point hike at the 8-9 December meeting, and Waller has floated a half point.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields high
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 103.9, its highest since April 2025, and the US 10-year yield is near 5.05% (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Weak data ignored
bullets.text: The Philly Fed index fell to a six-month low, but gold kept dropping because rate-hike fears outweigh it.

bullets.title: Hormuz not helping
bullets.text: Iran and Strait of Hormuz headlines escalated, but they did not lift gold today, though sudden spikes are still possible (details UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Silver hit too
bullets.text: Silver fell about 5% to near 44.93, which shows broad selling in metals (Mitrade).

bullets.title: Stretched trend
bullets.text: One Kitco analyst sees room down to 3,500, but the move is oversold, so sharp bounces into old lows are likely.
